column7: SetSecretAutoRotate persisted its pre-read snapshot via UpdateSecret's GORM Save; a DeleteSecret on another replica after the read was undone by Save's upsert fallback (deleted_at=NULL, no RestoreSecret, no audit), and the same stale write reverted a concurrent admin backend binding (#90) and cleared ownership. Fixed with UpdateSecretRotationConfig, a rotation-columns-only UPDATE WHERE live AND same project AND rotation_backend = the pre-read value the admin gate used. Found by C-GUARD2-EXEMPT-REVIEW (#2662)
